citations.claim: energy still at initial level one step before the violating collision resolves
energy jumps ~356 J above initial at first violating step while the pair is in contact

counterfactual.change: Set restitution e to 0.0 on both bodies (two fields); removes the restitution impulse at the oblique impact, so no energy is created and the run passes.

explanation: Oblique high-speed circle-circle impact between unequal masses (1 vs 12.39) with restitution (0.8/1.0) creates energy: energy is flat (~2519.75 J) through step 78 while the pair approaches (gap 0.014), then jumps to ~2875.5 J at step 79 as the contact resolves (gap 0.0046), exceeding E0+10%+5. With controller disabled and work 0 this must be the contact solver. Likely the normal restitution impulse and/or positional correction mishandles the tangential component of an oblique impact (or sequential substep impulses double-count), injecting kinetic energy; zeroing restitution removes it.
vision_note: Two blue circles stay in close oblique contact near the centre-right from steps 76 to 79 with almost no visible displacement or separation. No explosion, tunneling, walls or waypoints are visible, so the energy jump has no obvious positional signature.
